paper.abstract_en: We present the three-dimensional helicity distribution, $g_{1L}(x, k_T)$, of the proton, extracted using the azimuthal-independent longitudinal double-spin asymmetry (DSA) in semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering (SIDIS) processes. Utilizing data from the HERMES and CLAS collaborations, we find that the quark polarizations, defined as the ratio of the helicity distribution function to the unpolarized parton distribution function (PDF), are consistent with the predictions of Wigner rotation. Furthermore, we provide a projection study for the proposed Electron-ion Collider in China (EicC). The results demonstrate that future high-precision data from the EicC will significantly reduce the uncertainties of transverse momentum dependent helicity distributions and provide stringent constraints on the three-dimensional spin structure of the nucleon.
